summary: --- name: Clawdbot description: Use when setting up, configuring, or troubleshooting OpenClaw agents, channels, models, tools, automation, or gateway operations. Reach for this skill when users ask about agent configuration, connecting messaging platforms, enabling tools, managing sessions, or deploying the OpenClaw gateway. metadata: mintlify-proj: clawdbot version: "1.0" --- # clawdbot OpenClaw is an agentic AI platform that runs a single embedded agent runtime with configurable channels (Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, etc.), tools, models, and automation. Agents operate from a workspace directory with bootstrap files (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, etc.) and are managed through a JSON5 config file at `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`. The gateway listens on port 18789 and exposes a Control UI dashboard, RPC API, and CLI commands. **Key files and commands:**
